sources.location: Page 1, Controls, pickup PCB revision labels and selector diagram
sources.scope: The supplied image shows two 25k push-pulls, a three-position neck/both/bridge selector, and a 9 V battery. The volume pulls for Voice 2 and the tone pulls for Voice 3. The desired pushed-in Voice 2 differs from this diagram. The depicted pickup revisions and selector terminals still need checking against the RG80F hardware.

locations: Neck Rev 4.1 and bridge Rev 5.1 labels

sources.title: Fishman Fluence Open Core Install Guide
sources.location: Printed pp. 6–8, Connection Points & Functions items 2–4
sources.scope: For the configuration described, Voice 3 takes precedence when its select input is grounded, even if Voice 2 is also selected. With the factory solder jumper intact, Voice 3 uses the inner coils for the neck/bridge pair. Verify applicability to the installed revisions and confirm behavior on the bench.

sources.title: Fishman technical support correspondence, October 19–20, 2026
sources.access: Private correspondence. This entry is a paraphrase. Consult the original replies before PCB work.
sources.location: October 19 reply on the pickup-bottom solder jumper and October 20 replies on independent Voice 3 and coil selection
sources.scope: For the separate inner/outer coil selection goal, Fishman described removing a solder jumper on the pickup PCB to access pads. The reply described CT to ground for inner coils and CT to H for outer coils, with Voice 3 controlled separately. Fishman did not supply a single diagram for that exact custom control arrangement. This is conditional guidance for that project phase, not a baseline step.

verification_needed: Confirm the PCB revisions and actual 3-way selector terminal map.
Confirm which push-pull contacts close when pushed in and pulled.
Check Voice 3 with both volume settings. In the proposed layout, volume pushed in and tone pulled is the state that requests both Voice 2 and Voice 3.
For later independent coil switching, verify both PCB revisions and the applicable support diagrams before changing any solder jumper.
